45270396.name: JWH-210
45270396.description: JWH-210 is an analgesic chemical from the naphthoylindole family, which acts as a potent cannabinoid agonist at both the CB1 and CB2 receptors, with Ki values of 0.46 nM at CB1 and 0.69 nM at CB2.

50899324.name: Enarodustat
50899324.description: Enarodustat (development code JTZ-951; brand name Enaroy) is a drug used for the treatment of anemia, especially when associated with chronic kidney disease .

51039100.name: Tigulixostat
51039100.description: Tigulixostat is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated for the treatment of gout. It is a xanthine oxidase inhibitor.

53325692.name: Desmethylchlorotrianisene
53325692.description: Desmethylchlorotrianisene is a nonsteroidal estrogen which is thought to be the major active metabolite of chlorotrianisene .

54682876.name: Tasquinimod
54682876.description: Tasquinimod is an experimental drug currently being investigated for the treatment of solid tumors.

56842108.name: Phentermine/topiramate
56842108.description: Phentermine/topiramate, sold under the brand name Qsymia, is a combination drug of phentermine and topiramate used to treat obesity.

59657596.name: RG7713
59657596.description: RG7713, or RG-7713, also known as RO5028442, is a small-molecule vasopression V1A receptor antagonist which is or was under development for the treatment of pervasive developmental disorders or autism.

70693500.name: Plecanatide
70693500.description: Plecanatide, sold under the brand name Trulance, is a medication for the treatment of chronic idiopathic constipation and irritable bowel syndrome with constipation.

70697724.name: Bruceanol D
70697724.description: Bruceanol D is a cytotoxic quassinoid isolated from Brucea antidysenterica with potential antitumor and antileukemic properties.

73187452.name: Rhodium acetylacetonate
73187452.description: Rhodium acetylacetonate is the coordination complex with the formula Rh 3, which is sometimes known as Rh 3.

73386748.name: Nacubactam
73386748.description: Nacubactam is an investigational β-lactamase inhibitor being developed for the treatment of infections caused by carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae .

76283388.name: MT-1207
76283388.description: MT-1207 is a combined serotonin 5-HT2A receptor antagonist, α1-adrenergic receptor antagonist, and calcium channel blocker which is under development for the treatment of hypertension .

82282492.name: BK-NM-AMT
82282492.description: BK-NM-AMT, or βk-NM-αMT, also known as β-keto-N-methyl-αMT or α,N-dimethyl-β-ketotryptamine, as well as 3-indoylmethcathinone, is a serotonin–dopamine releasing agent and putative entactogen of the...

90472060.name: Lixisenatide
90472060.description: Lixisenatide (trade name Lyxumia in the European Union and Adlyxin in the U.S. and manufactured by Sanofi) is a once-daily injectable GLP-1 receptor agonist for the treatment of type 2 diabetes.

91825660.name: Triplatin tetranitrate
91825660.description: Triplatin tetranitrate (rINN; also known as BBR3464, https://www.bioplatinumtech.com/) is a platinum-based cytotoxic drug that underwent clinical trials for the treatment of human cancer.

102066428.name: Momordenol
102066428.description: Momordenol is a natural chemical compound, a sterol found in the fresh fruit of the bitter melon .

121225724.name: Glycopyrronium tosylate
121225724.description: Glycopyrronium tosylate, sold under the brand name Qbrexza in the United States, is a medication used for the treatment of primary axillary hyperhidrosis.

121233660.name: Ammonium dihydrogen arsenate
121233660.description: Ammonium dihydrogen arsenate is an inorganic chemical compound with the chemical formula NH4H2AsO4.

122497020.name: PRT543
122497020.description: PRT543 is an experimental anticancer drug which acts as an inhibitor of the enzyme protein arginine methyltransferase 5.

129651196.name: Tin(IV) iodate
129651196.description: Tin iodate is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula Sn 4.

129665404.name: Tetrakis(cyclopentadienyl)uranium(IV)
129665404.description: Tetrakis uranium , U 4, abbreviated U 4, is an organouranium compound composed of a uranium atom sandwiched between four cyclopentadienide rings.

139203580.name: Lead(II) laurate
139203580.description: Lead laurate is a metal-organic compound with the chemical formula Pb(O2C 10CH3)2.

164536956.name: Anvumetostat
164536956.description: Anvumetostat is an investigational new drug that is being developed by Amgen for the treatment of methylthioadenosine phosphorylase -null solid tumors. Anvumetostat acts as a PRMT5 inhibitor.

168969724.name: Lonitoclax
168969724.description: Lonitoclax is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated by Lomond Therapeutics for the treatment of acute myeloid leukemia and chronic lymphocytic leukaemia . It acts as an Bcl-2 inhibitor.

169149436.name: 2C-CPe
169149436.description: 2C-CPe, also known as 4-cyclopentyl-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a designer drug from the substituted phenethylamine family, which was first synthesised by Josh Hartsel and colleagues in 2024.

900000124.name: Alefacept
900000124.description: Alefacept is a genetically engineered immunosuppressive drug.

900000380.name: Calcium alginate
900000380.description: Calcium alginate is a water-insoluble, gelatinous, cream-coloured substance that can be created through the addition of aqueous calcium chloride to aqueous sodium alginate.

900001148.name: Linvoseltamab
900001148.description: Linvoseltamab, sold under the brand name Lynozyfic, is an anti-cancer medication used for the treatment of people with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.

900001532.name: Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine
900001532.description: The Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine, sold under the brand name Comirnaty, is an mRNA-based COVID-19 vaccine developed by the German biotechnology company BioNTech.

900001660.name: Polysilicone-15
900001660.description: Polysilicone-15 is an organic compound used in hair products like shampoos, conditioners, hair sprays, pomades and color treatment products to absorb UVB radiation.

900001788.name: Reteplase
900001788.description: Reteplase, trade names include Retavase, is a thrombolytic drug, used to treat heart attacks by breaking up the clots that cause them.

900001916.name: Sotrovimab
900001916.description: Sotrovimab, sold under the brand name Xevudy, is a human neutralizing monoclonal antibody with activity against severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2, known as SARS-CoV-2.

900002044.name: Tisagenlecleucel
900002044.description: Tisagenlecleucel, sold under the brand name Kymriah, is a CAR T cells medication for the treatment of B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia which uses the body's own T cells to fight cancer .
